name: Alu Puri
ingredients: Mustard oil or ghee for frying
instructions: 1. Knead the whole wheat flour with water, a pinch of salt, and a tablespoon of oil into a firm dough and let it rest for 20 minutes.
2. To make the curry, heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds and asafoetida. Add ginger and green chilies.
3. Add mashed potatoes and all dry spices (turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, amchur, salt). Sauté for a few minutes.
4. Pour in 1.5 cups of water, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes until the gravy thickens; garnish with fresh coriander.
5. Roll small portions of the dough into circular puris and deep-fry them in hot oil until golden brown and puffed.
6. Serve hot puris with the spiced potato curry.
description: Alu Puri is a quintessential Haryanvi breakfast, favored for its simplicity and robustness. It reflects the agricultural heartland's diet, prioritizing hearty, energy-dense ingredients. Often prepared during festivals and slow weekend mornings, it is a comfort food that brings families together across the state.
